blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Scott Creek rose from 3 in June to 7 in October (+133.3%), and 7 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.9% of Coquitlam’s 779 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Scott Creek?
Scott Creek also had 4 houses listed and 1 sold in October, against 7 condos and townhomes listed. The Scott Creek houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Scott Creek?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 7 condos and townhomes listed in Scott Creek. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Scott Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Scott Creek had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Scott Creek from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 7 condos and townhomes sold in Scott Creek over those 5 months, out of 596 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Scott Creek sell for?
faq.a: 9 townhomes sold in Scott Creek between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,049,900.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Scott Creek?
faq.a: The median was 2 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 100.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
